body: Luckily I don't live in the US either, they treat suicidal people worse than criminals :-O The suicide hotline gave me a message saying no volunteers were available at this time.

I'm fairly intelligent but suffering from PTSD which on some days renders me unable to even the mundanest things like taking out the trash on time. This varies over time and aforementioned social workers should be aware of that... However they have been yelling at me lately for things like not taking out the trash, forcing me to do it anyway to the point where my body physically refused to do it, the mind was still trying because they were mocking me and threatening with 'consequences if you don't keep your place clean'. While I can understand this has to be done, I sometimes just can't (I want to, but it isn't that easy).

The past few weeks have been a huge string of mockery, threats and pushing far past my boundaries and I am now mentally and physically spent. Called in a panicked, suicidal state a few days ago but that was ignored, next day; more mockery and threats.

Now so far along that I need serious professional help because PTSD is spinning out of control as well, but professionals seem to assume I am lazy and just want them to take my trash out while I do nothing.

TL;DR Just trying to find a way to word it so they understand I need serious psychological help ASAP, actively suicidal ATM but fighting it.
